name: VD Agent local golden evals
inspiration: Golden tasks, trace checks, and release smoke gates.

tiers.name: Functional & component
tiers.goal: Verify deterministic scaffolding: prompt shaping, parsing, model fallback classification, path resolution, persistence, and IPC helpers.

tiers.name: Trajectory & tool
tiers.goal: Verify that the agent chooses and recovers through the right tool/provider sequence, reports failed tools, rejects fabricated work, and keeps provider fallback transparent.

tiers.name: Visual & end-to-end
tiers.goal: Launch the real Electron app with a throwaway profile and verify UI, IPC, window isolation, editor rendering, chat restore, and safe external-link behavior.

cases.prompt: Pure helper coverage for system prompt, response cleanup, failed tool formatting, provider errors, and unverified claims.
checks: Filler openers and closers are stripped outside code blocks.
Tool failure messages include args, error, and a useful hint.
Provider errors are classified into rate, network, server, model, context, or other.
Live model discovery removes stale configured IDs and stores the refreshed provider catalog.
Claims of edits, commands, or passing tests require matching tool calls.

cases.prompt: Relative filesystem and command tools resolve against the open workspace and report failures correctly.
checks: Relative paths resolve under workspace.
Non-zero command exits are surfaced as failures.
Timeouts include a clear timeout message.
A missing file reaches the model as Tool read_file FAILED.
A valid relative file path resolves against the workspace.
Malformed tool JSON is reported to the model.
Later rounds stay on the provider that answered after fallback.

cases.prompt: SMOKE-EMPTY where is the setting read from?
checks: An empty model reply triggers one corrective retry.
The next model is tried before the same empty model again.

cases.prompt: SMOKE-CLAIM fix the add bug in calc.js
checks: A reply claiming edits or tests without tool evidence is not shown.
The model receives a correction prompt and produces an honest answer.
All tried providers are listed.
Each failure is categorized.
The user receives concrete next steps.

cases.prompt: Launch the app, restore a workspace, open smoke-editor.ts, and render Monaco.
checks: Window title, renderer isolation, and preload API are valid.
Saved chat restores across restart.
Chat header remains visible after restore.
Bundled Monaco opens a workspace file without CDN access.

cases.prompt: Refresh the active provider's live model list before the chat request.
checks: Live `/models` discovery is saved to the provider catalog.
The strongest live model replaces a stale configured default.
Deprecated model IDs not returned by discovery are not kept in the saved catalog.
